senses.en: to plan and direct the route of a ship, aircraft, or vehicle
to find one's way through a difficult place or situation
senses.zh: 順利通過；應付（複雜情況）

ex.en: New students often need a map to navigate the huge campus.
ex.zh: 新生常常需要地圖才能在偌大的校園裡找到路。

root.note: 駕駛船隻 → 導航

senses.en: a cloud of gas and dust in outer space

ex.en: The telescope captured a glowing nebula where new stars are forming.
ex.zh: 望遠鏡拍到一團正在形成新恆星的發光星雲。

root.note: 太空中的雲霧 → 星雲

mn: 形容詞 nebulous 是「模糊不清的」，像雲霧一樣。

senses.en: required to be done or achieved; needed
happening as an unavoidable result

ex.en: It is necessary to wear a helmet when you ride a motorcycle.
ex.zh: 騎機車時必須戴安全帽。

root.note: 不能退讓、省略的 → 必要的

senses.en: to make something necessary as a result

ex.en: The broken pipe will necessitate closing the school for a day.
ex.zh: 水管破裂將使學校必須停課一天。

root.note: 使變得必要

senses.en: the state of being required; something that is needed

ex.en: For many families, a car is a necessity rather than a luxury.
ex.zh: 對許多家庭而言，汽車是必需品而不是奢侈品。

root.note: 必要的東西 → 必需品

mn: 諺語：Necessity is the mother of invention.（需要為發明之母）

senses.en: a list of people who have died recently; an obituary

ex.en: The alumni magazine publishes a necrology in every issue.
ex.zh: 校友雜誌每期都會刊登一份過世校友名單。

root.note: 記錄死者的文字 → 死亡名單

senses.en: a person who claims to communicate with the dead; a sorcerer

ex.en: In the fantasy novel, a necromancer raises an army of skeletons.
ex.zh: 在那本奇幻小說裡，一名巫師召喚出一支骷髏大軍。

root.note: 透過死者占卜的人 → 通靈師、巫師

senses.en: a large ancient cemetery

ex.en: Archaeologists uncovered painted tombs in the ancient necropolis.
ex.zh: 考古學家在古代大墓地裡發現了彩繪墳墓。

root.note: 死者之城 → 大墓地

senses.en: the death of cells or tissue in a part of the body

ex.en: Frostbite can lead to necrosis of the fingers and toes.
ex.zh: 凍傷可能導致手指和腳趾壞死。

root.note: 組織死亡的狀態 → 壞死

senses.en: a sweet liquid produced by flowers and collected by bees
(in Greek myth) the drink of the gods; any delicious drink

ex.en: Hummingbirds hover in front of flowers to sip nectar.
ex.zh: 蜂鳥在花前盤旋吸食花蜜。

senses.en: a kind of peach with smooth skin

ex.en: She packed a ripe nectarine in her lunch box.
ex.zh: 她在午餐盒裡放了一顆熟透的油桃。

root.note: 像花蜜一樣甜的水果 → 油桃

senses.en: sewing or embroidery; articles made this way

ex.en: Her grandmother's needlework hangs framed in the living room.
ex.zh: 她祖母的刺繡作品裱框掛在客廳裡。

root.note: 用針做的工作 → 針線活

senses.en: lacking the necessities of life; very poor
needing a lot of emotional support or attention
senses.zh: （情感上）很黏人的；需要關注的

ex.en: The charity delivers hot meals to needy families every weekend.
ex.zh: 這個慈善團體每個週末都會送熱食給貧困家庭。

senses.en: wicked or criminal

ex.en: The hackers used the stolen data for nefarious purposes.
ex.zh: 駭客把偷來的資料拿去做不法的勾當。

root.note: 違反神的律法 → 邪惡的

senses.en: to cancel out the effect of something
to deny the existence or truth of

ex.en: Eating junk food every night will negate the benefits of your workouts.
ex.zh: 每晚吃垃圾食物會抵銷你運動的效果。

root.note: 說「不」→ 否定、使無效

senses.en: the act of denying or contradicting
the absence or opposite of something

ex.en: Censorship is the negation of free speech.
ex.zh: 審查制度就是言論自由的反面。

root.note: 否定的行為

senses.en: failing to give proper care or attention

ex.en: The neglectful landlord ignored the tenants' complaints about the leaking roof.
ex.zh: 那個不負責的房東對房客抱怨屋頂漏水置之不理。

root.note: 沒有撿起來照顧 → 疏忽的

senses.en: a light, thin dressing gown worn by women

ex.en: The actress wore a silk negligee in the bedroom scene.
ex.zh: 那位女演員在臥室那場戲裡穿著一件絲質睡袍。

root.note: 不講究穿著、隨意的衣服 → 睡袍

senses.en: failure to take proper care; carelessness

ex.en: The accident was caused by the driver's negligence.
ex.zh: 這場意外是駕駛的疏忽造成的。

parts.m: choose, pick up 選、拾起（= lect）

root.note: 不去照料 → 疏忽

senses.en: failing to take proper care in doing something

ex.en: The court ruled that the hospital had been negligent in its care of the patient.
ex.zh: 法院判定醫院在照護病人上有疏失。

parts.m: choose, pick up 選、拾起（= lect）

root.note: 不去照料的 → 疏忽的

mn: negligent 是「疏忽的」，negligible 是「可忽略的、微不足道的」，別搞混。

senses.en: so small or unimportant that it is not worth considering

ex.en: The difference in price between the two phones is negligible.
ex.zh: 這兩支手機的價差微不足道。

root.note: 可以不去理會的 → 可忽略的

senses.en: open to discussion or change
(of a road or obstacle) able to be passed or crossed

ex.en: The salary is negotiable, depending on your experience.
ex.zh: 薪資可依經驗商議。

root.note: 不閒著、做生意 → 談判 → 可協商的

senses.en: (Greek myth) the goddess of retribution who punishes pride
senses.zh: （希臘神話）復仇女神涅墨西斯

senses.en: (lowercase) a long-standing enemy or rival; a source of downfall
senses.zh: （小寫）死對頭；剋星；應得的懲罰

ex.en: In Greek myth, Nemesis punished mortals who became too proud.
ex.zh: 在希臘神話中，涅墨西斯會懲罰過於驕傲的凡人。

root.note: 分配應得的報應 → 復仇女神 → 剋星

senses.en: the modern theory of evolution combining natural selection with genetics

ex.en: Neo-Darwinism explains evolution through natural selection acting on genetic variation.
ex.zh: 新達爾文主義以天擇作用於基因變異來解釋演化。

root.note: 新的達爾文學說

senses.en: Latin as used in scholarly writing from the Renaissance onward
senses.zh: 新拉丁語（文藝復興後的學術拉丁文）

ex.en: Many scientific names for plants are written in neo-Latin.
ex.zh: 許多植物的學名是用新拉丁語寫成的。

root.note: 較新時期的拉丁文

senses.en: government by new or inexperienced people

ex.en: Critics warned that the cabinet full of first-time officials was a neocracy.
ex.zh: 批評者警告，這個滿是新手官員的內閣是外行人當政。

root.note: 由新人統治 → 新手政治

senses.en: relating to the later Stone Age, when farming began and polished stone tools were used

ex.en: Farming spread across Europe during the Neolithic period.
ex.zh: 農業在新石器時代傳遍了歐洲。

root.note: 新的石器 → 新石器時代的

senses.en: the creation or use of new words or new meanings

ex.en: Social media has sped up neology, with new slang appearing every month.
ex.zh: 社群媒體加快了新詞的產生，每個月都有新的流行語出現。

root.note: 新的字 → 造新詞

senses.en: a modern revival of pre-Christian nature religions

ex.en: Neopaganism often draws on ancient festivals marking the seasons.
ex.zh: 新異教主義常借用古代慶祝季節的節日。

root.note: 新興的異教信仰

senses.en: a beginner in a skill or activity; a new convert

ex.en: As a neophyte in the kitchen, he burned the rice twice.
ex.zh: 他是廚房新手，把飯燒焦了兩次。

root.note: 新種下的植物 → 新手

senses.en: to settle comfortably and snugly
to be situated in a sheltered position

ex.en: The puppy likes to nestle against its mother to keep warm.
ex.zh: 小狗喜歡依偎在媽媽身邊取暖。

root.note: 像待在巢裡一樣 → 依偎

senses.en: a young bird that is too young to leave the nest

ex.en: The mother robin brought worms to her hungry nestling.
ex.zh: 知更鳥媽媽帶蟲回來給飢餓的雛鳥。

root.note: 巢裡的小東西 → 雛鳥

senses.en: a plant with leaves covered in stinging hairs
to irritate or annoy

ex.en: His constant interruptions began to nettle the speaker.
ex.zh: 他不斷插嘴，開始惹惱演講者。

mn: 被蕁麻刺到會又癢又痛，所以 nettle 引申為「惹惱」。

senses.en: a system of connected people, things, or computers
to meet and exchange information with people for professional benefit

ex.en: The city has an efficient network of buses and subways.
ex.zh: 這座城市有很有效率的公車與捷運網路。

root.note: 網狀的結構

senses.en: relating to nerves or the nervous system

ex.en: Scientists studied the neural activity of patients while they slept.
ex.zh: 科學家研究病人睡眠時的神經活動。

root.note: 神經的

senses.en: the branch of medicine dealing with the nervous system

ex.en: She decided to specialize in neurology after her father's stroke.
ex.zh: 她父親中風後，她決定專攻神經科。

root.note: 研究神經的學問

senses.en: (grammar) neither masculine nor feminine
to remove the reproductive organs of an animal

ex.en: The shelter will neuter every cat before it is adopted.
ex.zh: 收容所會在每隻貓被領養前替牠結紮。

root.note: 兩者皆非 → 中性的

senses.en: not supporting either side in a conflict
having no strong qualities; (of color) not bright

ex.en: Switzerland stayed neutral during both world wars.
ex.zh: 瑞士在兩次世界大戰中都保持中立。

root.note: 不站在任何一邊 → 中立的

senses.en: in spite of that; however

ex.en: The hike was exhausting; nevertheless, the view from the top made it worthwhile.
ex.zh: 這趟健行很累人，儘管如此，山頂的景色讓一切都值得了。

senses.en: relating to Isaac Newton or his laws of physics

ex.en: Newtonian physics works well for everyday objects but fails near the speed of light.
ex.zh: 牛頓力學適用於日常物體，但接近光速時就不適用了。

root.note: 與牛頓有關的

senses.en: unwilling to spend or give; stingy; (of an amount) meager
senses.zh: 吝嗇的；（數量）少得可憐的

ex.en: The company gave its workers a niggardly raise of one percent.
ex.zh: 公司只給員工少得可憐的百分之一加薪。

mn: 此字與種族歧視用語無關，但因發音相近常引起誤會，寫作時可改用 stingy。

senses.en: a person who believes life is meaningless and rejects moral principles

ex.en: The novel's hero is a bitter nihilist who believes in nothing.
ex.zh: 小說主角是個憤世嫉俗、什麼都不相信的虛無主義者。

root.note: 相信一切皆空的人

senses.en: nothing; zero

ex.en: Without funding, the project's chances of success are nil.
ex.zh: 沒有資金，這個計畫成功的機會等於零。

parts.m: nothing 無（拉丁文 nihil 縮寫）

root.note: 無 → 零

senses.en: quick and light in movement
quick to understand and think

ex.en: The pianist's nimble fingers raced across the keys.
ex.zh: 鋼琴家靈巧的手指在琴鍵上飛快移動。

senses.en: the egg of a louse
(informal) a foolish person

ex.en: The nurse checked each child's hair for a nit or two.
ex.zh: 護理師檢查每個孩子的頭髮裡有沒有蝨卵。

mn: nitpick（挑蝨卵）引申為「吹毛求疵」。

senses.en: active at night
happening at night

ex.en: Owls are nocturnal birds that hunt after dark.
ex.zh: 貓頭鷹是夜行性鳥類，天黑後才出來獵食。

root.note: 夜晚的

senses.en: making no sound; silent

ex.en: The electric car made a noiseless departure from the driveway.
ex.zh: 電動車無聲無息地駛離車道。

root.note: 沒有聲音的

senses.en: having an extremely unpleasant smell; offensive
harmful or unhealthy

ex.en: A noisome smell rose from the overflowing garbage bins.
ex.zh: 滿出來的垃圾桶飄出一股惡臭。

root.note: 令人厭煩的 → 惡臭的

mn: noisome 跟 noise 無關！意思是「惡臭的」，不是「吵鬧的」。

senses.en: making a lot of noise; full of noise

ex.en: It was hard to study in the noisy café.
ex.zh: 在嘈雜的咖啡店裡很難讀書。

senses.en: a member of a people who move from place to place
a person who wanders without a fixed home

ex.en: The nomad moved his herd of goats to greener pastures each season.
ex.zh: 這位遊牧民每一季都把羊群趕往更肥沃的草場。

root.note: 四處放牧的人 → 遊牧民

mn: digital nomad：數位遊牧族，帶著筆電到處工作的人。

senses.en: customary or conventional, especially of spelling

ex.en: The dictionary lists the nomic spelling first and older variants after it.
ex.zh: 字典先列出通行拼法，再列出較舊的變體。

parts.m: law, custom 法則、慣例（希臘文 nomos）

root.note: 合乎慣例的 → 通行的

senses.en: existing in name only
(of a price or amount) very small

ex.en: The museum charges only a nominal fee for students.
ex.zh: 博物館只向學生收取象徵性的費用。

root.note: 只有名字的 → 名義上的

senses.en: to propose someone as a candidate for an election, award, or position
to appoint someone to a job

ex.en: The club voted to nominate her for president.
ex.zh: 社團投票提名她擔任社長。

root.note: 叫出名字 → 提名

senses.en: the act of formally suggesting someone for a position or award

ex.en: The film received a nomination for Best Picture.
ex.zh: 這部電影獲得最佳影片提名。

root.note: 提出名字的行為 → 提名

senses.en: a person who has been nominated

ex.en: Each nominee gave a short speech before the vote.
ex.zh: 每位被提名人在投票前都發表了簡短演說。

root.note: 被提名的人

senses.en: a person who is not fighting in a war, such as a civilian or medic

ex.en: International law forbids attacks on any non-combatant.
ex.zh: 國際法禁止攻擊任何非戰鬥人員。

root.note: 不參與打鬥的人 → 非戰鬥人員

senses.en: not existing or not real

ex.en: Public transportation in the small village is almost non-existent.
ex.zh: 那個小村莊幾乎沒有大眾運輸。

root.note: 沒有站出來、出現的 → 不存在的

senses.en: a person who does not live in a particular place
not living in a particular place

ex.en: As a non-resident, he had to pay higher tuition at the state university.
ex.zh: 身為非本州居民，他在州立大學得付較高的學費。

root.note: 沒有住下來的人 → 非居民

senses.en: a relaxed, calm manner that shows no anxiety or interest
senses.zh: 漫不經心；冷靜；若無其事

ex.en: She hid her nerves behind an air of nonchalance.
ex.zh: 她用一副若無其事的樣子掩飾緊張。

parts.m: be warm, care 熱心、在乎（拉丁文 calere）

root.note: 不熱衷、不在乎 → 漫不經心

senses.en: lacking distinctive or interesting features

ex.en: The spy drove a nondescript gray car so no one would notice him.
ex.zh: 那名間諜開著一輛毫不起眼的灰色汽車，好讓人不注意到他。

root.note: 無法被描寫下來的 → 沒特色的

senses.en: a person or thing with no importance

ex.en: Before his big discovery, he was a nonentity in the scientific world.
ex.zh: 在他有重大發現之前，他在科學界是個無名小卒。

root.note: 像不存在一樣 → 無足輕重的人

senses.en: having no equal; unrivaled
a person or thing without equal

ex.en: She was a nonpareil chess player who never lost a tournament.
ex.zh: 她是無人能敵的西洋棋手，從未輸過任何比賽。

root.note: 沒有相等的 → 無雙的

senses.en: something that is usual or standard
an accepted standard of behavior in a society

ex.en: Working from home has become the norm for many office workers.
ex.zh: 在家工作已成為許多上班族的常態。

parts.m: rule, carpenter's square 規矩、曲尺

root.note: 木匠的曲尺 → 標準、規範

senses.en: the state of being normal; the usual condition

ex.en: After the typhoon, the town slowly returned to normalcy.
ex.zh: 颱風過後，小鎮慢慢恢復正常。

root.note: 合乎標準的狀態 → 常態

senses.en: a member of the people from Normandy who conquered England in 1066
relating to the Normans or their style of architecture
senses.zh: 諾曼人的；諾曼式（建築）的

ex.en: The castle's thick walls and rounded arches are typical Norman features.
ex.zh: 這座城堡的厚牆和圓拱是典型的諾曼式特徵。

root.note: 北方人（維京人後裔）→ 諾曼人

senses.en: a medicine of doubtful effectiveness sold by an unqualified person
a favorite but ineffective remedy for social or political problems
senses.zh: （解決問題的）萬靈丹；靈丹妙藥

ex.en: Cutting taxes is his nostrum for every economic problem.
ex.zh: 減稅是他解決所有經濟問題的萬靈丹。

parts.m: our 我們的（拉丁文 noster）

root.note: 「我們自家的」祕方 → 偏方

senses.en: easily seen or noticed; clear

ex.en: There has been a noticeable improvement in her writing this semester.
ex.zh: 她這學期的寫作有明顯的進步。

root.note: 可以被注意到的

senses.en: famous for something bad
senses.zh: 惡名昭彰的；聲名狼藉的

ex.en: This intersection is notorious for traffic accidents.
ex.zh: 這個路口以車禍頻傳而惡名昭彰。

root.note: 人人都知道（的壞事）→ 惡名昭彰

mn: famous 是好名聲，notorious 是壞名聲。

senses.en: a short novel, often light or romantic
senses.zh: 中篇小說；短篇（通俗）小說

ex.en: She finished the romantic novelette in a single afternoon.
ex.zh: 她一個下午就讀完了那部浪漫的中篇小說。

root.note: 小的小說 → 中篇小說

senses.en: a person new to and inexperienced in an activity
a person who has entered a religious order but not yet taken final vows

ex.en: This ski slope is too steep for a novice.
ex.zh: 這條滑雪道對新手來說太陡了。

root.note: 新來的人 → 新手

senses.en: at the present time, in contrast with the past

ex.en: Nowadays, most people read the news on their phones.
ex.zh: 現今大多數人都用手機看新聞。

senses.en: not in or to any place
a remote or unimportant place

ex.en: The keys were nowhere to be found.
ex.zh: 鑰匙到處都找不到。

mn: 片語 in the middle of nowhere：在荒郊野外。

senses.en: harmful, poisonous, or very unpleasant
senses.zh: 有毒的；有害的；令人不快的

ex.en: The factory was fined for releasing noxious fumes into the air.
ex.zh: 那間工廠因排放有毒氣體到空氣中而被罰款。

root.note: 造成傷害的 → 有害的

senses.en: a subtle difference in meaning, expression, or tone

ex.en: A good translator captures every nuance of the original text.
ex.zh: 好的譯者能掌握原文的每個細微差異。

root.note: 像雲一樣的濃淡變化 → 細微差別

senses.en: the central part of an atom or cell
the central and most important part of a group or thing

ex.en: These five players form the nucleus of the team.
ex.zh: 這五名球員組成了球隊的核心。

root.note: 果仁 → 核心

senses.en: wearing no clothes; naked
a painting or sculpture of a naked human figure

ex.en: The museum displays a famous marble nude from ancient Greece.
ex.zh: 博物館展出一尊來自古希臘的著名大理石裸像。

senses.en: of no value or importance; having no force

ex.en: Without enforcement, the new regulations are nugatory.
ex.zh: 如果沒有執行，這些新規定形同虛設。

root.note: 瑣碎不值一提的 → 無價值的

senses.en: a person or thing causing annoyance or trouble

ex.en: The mosquitoes were a constant nuisance during our camping trip.
ex.zh: 露營時蚊子一直很擾人。

root.note: 造成損害的東西 → 麻煩

senses.en: the act or method of counting or numbering

ex.en: The ancient Romans used a system of numeration based on letters.
ex.zh: 古羅馬人使用以字母為基礎的計數法。

root.note: 數數的方法

senses.en: relating to or expressed in numbers

ex.en: Please arrange the files in numerical order.
ex.zh: 請把檔案按數字順序排列。

root.note: 數字的

senses.en: a building where nuns live together; a convent

ex.en: The old nunnery has been turned into a quiet guesthouse.
ex.zh: 那座老修道院已改建成一間安靜的民宿。

root.note: 修女住的地方

senses.en: relating to marriage or weddings

ex.en: The couple signed a nuptial agreement before the wedding.
ex.zh: 這對新人在婚禮前簽了婚前協議。

root.note: 結婚的

mn: 複數 nuptials 可直接當名詞「婚禮」。

senses.en: to care for and encourage the growth of
upbringing and education, as opposed to inborn nature

ex.en: Good teachers nurture their students' curiosity.
ex.zh: 好老師會培養學生的好奇心。

root.note: 滋養 → 養育、培養

mn: nature vs. nurture：先天與後天之爭。

senses.en: a substance that provides nourishment; food

ex.en: The roots draw water and nutriment from the soil.
ex.zh: 根從土壤中吸取水分和養分。

root.note: 滋養身體的東西 → 養分

senses.en: providing nourishment; relating to nutrition

ex.en: Brown rice has more nutritive value than white rice.
ex.zh: 糙米的營養價值比白米高。

root.note: 能滋養的 → 有營養的

senses.en: made of oak wood

ex.en: The wine is aged in oaken barrels for three years.
ex.zh: 這款酒在橡木桶中陳釀三年。

root.note: 橡木做的

senses.en: loose fiber from old ropes, used to seal gaps between ship planks

ex.en: Sailors pressed oakum between the planks to keep the ship watertight.
ex.zh: 水手們把麻絮塞進船板縫隙，讓船不漏水。

senses.en: stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or course of action

ex.en: Despite the protests, the mayor remained obdurate about closing the library.
ex.zh: 儘管有人抗議，市長仍執意要關閉圖書館。

root.note: 非常硬的 → 頑固的

senses.en: a tall, four-sided stone pillar that narrows to a pointed top

ex.en: An ancient Egyptian obelisk stands in the middle of the square.
ex.zh: 廣場中央矗立著一座古埃及方尖碑。

parts.m: spit, pointed pillar 烤肉叉、尖柱（希臘文 obelos）

root.note: 像小烤肉叉一樣尖的柱子 → 方尖碑

senses.en: very overweight, in a way that is unhealthy

ex.en: Doctors worry that more children are becoming obese.
ex.zh: 醫生擔心越來越多孩子變得過胖。

root.note: 吃太多 → 肥胖的

senses.en: the condition of being very overweight

ex.en: Sugary drinks are a major cause of childhood obesity.
ex.zh: 含糖飲料是兒童肥胖的主要原因之一。

root.note: 吃太多的狀態 → 肥胖

senses.en: a notice of someone's death, often with a short biography

ex.en: The newspaper ran a long obituary about the famous architect.
ex.zh: 報紙刊登了一篇關於那位知名建築師的長篇訃聞。

root.note: 走向（死亡）→ 訃聞

senses.en: not influenced by personal feelings; based on facts
a goal or aim

ex.en: A judge must stay objective and consider only the evidence.
ex.zh: 法官必須保持客觀，只考慮證據。

parts.m: against, in front of 對著、在前

root.note: 丟在眼前的東西 → 客觀存在的事物；目標

senses.en: a person who expresses disapproval or opposition

ex.en: The only objector to the plan was the school principal.
ex.zh: 唯一反對這項計畫的人是校長。

root.note: 丟出反對意見的人

mn: conscientious objector：基於良心拒服兵役者。

senses.en: to bind someone legally or morally to do something

ex.en: The contract will obligate you to work here for two years.
ex.zh: 這份合約會使你有義務在這裡工作兩年。

root.note: 把人綁住 → 使負有義務

senses.en: required by law, rule, or custom
done out of habit rather than real feeling

ex.en: Attendance at the safety training is obligatory for all staff.
ex.zh: 所有員工都必須參加安全訓練。

root.note: 被綁住的 → 強制的

senses.en: slanting; neither parallel nor at a right angle
not expressed directly; indirect

ex.en: She made an oblique reference to his past mistakes.
ex.zh: 她拐彎抹角地提起他過去的錯誤。

root.note: 斜著朝向 → 傾斜的、間接的

senses.en: to destroy completely; to wipe out
to cover or blot out so as to be invisible

ex.en: The earthquake could obliterate the entire village.
ex.zh: 那場地震可能會把整個村莊夷為平地。

root.note: 把文字塗掉 → 抹去、徹底消滅

senses.en: the state of being forgotten
the state of being unaware of what is happening

ex.en: Many popular songs of the past have faded into oblivion.
ex.zh: 許多過去的流行歌曲已被人遺忘。

root.note: （記憶）被抹平 → 遺忘

senses.en: having a shape that is longer than it is wide; rectangular
an oblong shape

ex.en: We ate at a long oblong table in the dining hall.
ex.zh: 我們在餐廳一張長方形的長桌上用餐。

root.note: 特別長的 → 長方形的
